notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Dear Flippers,

We’re excited to announce that we’ve just released a new update focused exclusively on optimizing Garage Flipper’s performance. Thanks to your invaluable feedback 🤝 we’ve been able to refine key technical aspects to make gameplay smoother and more stable.

What’s Included in the Update?
Enhanced Graphics Performance: We’ve optimized the graphics engine to ensure smoother performance across a range of hardware setups, without the need for additional settings adjustments.

Improved Memory Management: With better memory utilization, you’ll experience greater stability, reducing the chances of sudden frame drops.

Reduced Loading Times and Increased Stability: Loading times have been shortened, and overall stability improved, allowing you to jump into the game faster and enjoy uninterrupted play.


Thank you for your support and feedback. We’re looking forward to hearing about your experience with these improvements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png

Best regards,
The Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are a few days past the launch of Garage Flipper, and we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for your support and valuable feedback. Thanks to your input, we've prepared our first update, which introduces significant fixes and improvements.

Changelog for the update:

Fixed the loading screen issue
We've resolved a bug that prevented the loading screen from displaying correctly for some players. The game should now start without any hiccups.

Added a UI button to exit the tablet
To make navigation smoother, we've added a new button that allows for quick exiting from the tablet. We hope this enhances your gaming experience.

Initial optimization improvements
We're working on making Garage Flipper run more smoothly on various hardware configurations. This update includes the first set of performance enhancements.

Fixed the issue with tools freezing when using the tablet
We've eliminated a bug that caused tools to freeze while using the tablet. You can now enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

Thank you for your patience and support. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so please continue sharing your suggestions. We're already working on future updates that will bring new features and further improvements.

Happy flipping!
The Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Update on progress
notes.notes:
Hello Flippers! 👋

It’s another devlog from our Garage in which your task is to turn dilapidated garages into real artworks. 🤩 

For the last couple of weeks we’ve dedicated our attention to polishing the already existing mechanics to ensure the quality of gameplay and experience in the game! 🔨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/7d904b625ac1dfeec4c14ecbc445129cede8226a.png
The part we’ve paid the most attention to was the tutorial. 👍

We are fully aware of how important a good tutorial is for players to be able to begin their adventure as garage flippers. 📝 Therefore, we’ve worked hard to make it intuitive and step by step to lead you through all the basic mechanics! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/293cdd9fab83177e2e7e4e68b75aacf90a11e7a5.jpg
The novelty we’ve been also working on is the new UI. We are doing our best to make playing Garage Flipper as smooth as possible. New, intuitive UI is constantly updated to ensure a quick movement through the menu and easy access to all the tools available. 👷

On top of that, we’ve added new commissions and enabled a sandbox mode to prepare your own garage in the lobby! 😍

That’s it for today! Don’t forget to add our game to your wishlists 👇 and join our discord 👇 to not miss on any updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764270/Garage_Flipper/?l=polish


See you soon,
Garage Flipper Team
